name: M1-5B-22, 2P
headline: Spectacular & Soaring 2 BDR  w/ Private Rooftop Jacuzzi & Beach Access
summary: This 2 bedroom penthouse is located in Gouna's only beachfront community with free pool and beach access and is managed by Xuru Stays.

description.Space:
This posh & fancy 2 bedroom penthouse is located in Gouna's only beachfront residence - Mangroovy with free pool and beach access. Mangroovy is closest to the Marina (10 min walk). 

The apartment is on the 2nd floor overlooking the pool and features a private rooftop with a jacuzzi - perfect for sun bathing and enjoying a drink! It also features an open plan fully equipped kitchen, 2 full bathrooms and a living room with a sofa bed that can sleep 2 additional guests. The apartment has 2 bedrooms with queen size beds and (both ensuite)  

There is a 55 inch smart TV with Airplay and cable channels, washing machine, a Nespresso machine, kettle and a microwave. The apartment is great for groups & big families. 

The elegant styling of the apartment, makes it one of a kind within its community.


At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment
description.Interaction:
We are more than happy to answer all of your questions 24/7. Guests can text and call anytime they need help and our team will be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Neighborhood:
-Mangroovy residence is uniquely located 800 meters from Marina El Gouna. Guests will be able to walk 10 minutes and get to it. 
-'Bright Star' supermarket is right in front of the residence towards the Marina.
-Mangroovy is home to the famous 'Noi' beach lounge (located at Mangroovy's beach)
- 'The Smokery', a local favorite is also located 450 meters from the residence.
description.Transit:
Free outdoor parking is available. 
Tuktuks are available to take you anywhere in El Gouna (flat fee 20 EGP).
description.Notes: Please note that smoking is not allowed inside the apartment. A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.

agreement:
Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 150 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 


Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

Die erste Nacht mussten wir im Treppenhaus bei Ratten schlafen, weil der versprochener Zimmerschlüssel im Zimmer Tresor nicht offenbar war. (man hatte uns den falschen Code gegeben und war auch telefonisch nicht mehr erreichbar, so dass wir von 1:00 Uhr, nachts bis morgens um 8:00 Uhr mit zwei kleinen Kindern im Treppenhaus schlafen mussten, am nächsten Tag haben wir dort Ratten rumlaufen sehen, eine eklige Vorstellung. ein Unding, um 8:00 Uhr morgens gab man uns dann einen anderen Code, der Schlüssel war dann aber nicht für diese Wohnung verwendbar, es dauerte eine weitere Stunde, bis sich jemand vom Housekeeping bemühte und dann reinzulassen)
Die Spülung der Toilette ging gar nicht, bei der anderen fiel die Spültaste immer wieder ab, ein Bett war so dreckig, dass wir es nicht nutzen konnten und der Putz bröckelte von den Wänden, die Wände waren feucht und es waren an vielen Stellen aufgeblühter Wände durch Feuchtigkeit. Die Steckdosen waren nicht ordentlich verankert und kam raus, ein Unding für Familie mit Kindern. Die Kabel waren nicht gesichert. Des Weiteren funktionierte die Klimaanlage nur ab und zu und es wurde sehr heiß. Außerdem war ein Toilettendeckel nicht ordentlich befestigt und viel ab, so dass wir auf dem nackten Porzellan sitzen mussten, diese Unterkunft ist überhaupt nicht zu empfehlen und der Service ist unter aller Kanone. Man hatte uns dann eine Refund von 10 % versprochen, auf den wir bis heute warten, auf Nachfragen gibt es immerVertröstungen, dass die Geschäftsführung das noch nicht entschieden hat. Versprochen war es allerdings schon lange. Ich habe jede Menge Fotos, die ich beifügen kann und rate eben nur dringend davon ab hier zu buchen.
